simple.meaning: אִשָּׁה (ʼishshâh) appears 65 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with priesthood. The occurrence trail connects the name with an offering.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Joshua, and 1 more, beginning at Exodus 29:18. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family line, offering, altar, priesthood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אִשָּׁה (H801) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows אִשָּׁה through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.

definitions.full: H801. ishsheh אִשֶּׁה noun masculine Josh 13:14 an offering made by fire (> Wetzst in De Psalmen, ed. 4, 889 derive from √ II. אנשׁ , means to friendly relations between God & man; compare Lag BN 190 ) Exod 29:18 32 t.; construct אִשֵּׁה Lev 1:9 14 t.; plural construct אִשֵּׁי 4:35 15 t.; suffix אִשַּׁי Num 28:2 , אִשָּׁ֑י Lev 6:10 ; used chiefly of offerings of animals, but also of the מִנְחָה 2:11 , and of the sacred bread and frankincense 24:7 , 9 which was placed on the table as a memorial, and finally went to the priests. The word is used in Deut 18:1 ; Josh 13:14 (D) 1Sam 2:28 ; elsewhere in P Lev 6:10 ; 10:15 ; 22:22 ; Num 28:2-3 , especially in phrases יהוה אִשֵּׁי Lev 2:3 11 t., ליהוה נִיחֹחַ רֵיחַ אִשֵּׁה 1:9 14 t., ליהוה אשׁה ניחח ריח Exod 29:18 6 t., ניחח ריח ליהוה אשׁה Lev 23:13 , ניחח לריח אשׁה 3:16 ; Num 18:17 , ליהוה (הוא) אשׁה Exod 29:25 ; Lev 2:16 ; ליהוה אִשֶּׁה accusative after verbs of offering Exod 30:20 14 t., ליהוה עֹלָה אִשֶּׁה Num 28:19 , אִשֶּׁהליהוה קָרְבָּן Lev 22:27 ; Num 15:25 .
